CITATION_BLOCK.title: European Commission — AI Act policy page (application timeline)
CITATION_BLOCK.excerpt_leq_25_words: AI Act entered into force 1 Aug 2024; phased applicability; prohibited practices and AI literacy apply from 2 Feb 2025.

CITATION_BLOCK.title: European Commission AI Act Service Desk — Annex III high-risk areas
CITATION_BLOCK.excerpt_leq_25_words: Annex III lists high-risk areas including employment, workers management and access to self-employment (recruitment/selection, filtering applications, evaluating candidates).

CITATION_BLOCK.title: EUR-Lex — Summary: rules for trustworthy AI in the EU (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689)
CITATION_BLOCK.excerpt_leq_25_words: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 sets risk-based rules to ensure trustworthy AI, protecting health, safety, and fundamental rights.

CITATION_BLOCK.title: NIST AI RMF 1.0 (NIST.AI.100-1)
CITATION_BLOCK.excerpt_leq_25_words: AI RMF provides a voluntary framework to manage AI risks across GOVERN, MAP, MEASURE, and MANAGE functions.
